editorial_rationale: Rev2 full-chapter layout was visually reviewed. Manga-fonts was rejected as too display-like for normal dialogue. Mac-dinh-3 was selected after direct chapter-output font comparison as the more natural comic dialogue face. Rev3 is a controlled typography-only rerender from the reviewed translation/layout baseline, with all 119 story objects forced to Mac-dinh-3 and Vietnamese glyph coverage hard-gated.
limitations: The operator runtime could not directly open the committed rev3 review PDFs during this session, so this approval is explicitly a delta review and does not claim a second full direct crop-by-crop inspection of rev3. The 56-slice and 16-page PDFs remain committed on the trial branch for audit/re-review.
